# Run 6 — `sdh-spot-check`, electron side: n = +3.2e12 cm^-2, D = 0; B 0 -> 10 T (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above). RAW.
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, current_channel

def spot_load(fid):
    r = run(fid)
    ch = resolve_channels(r.meta)
    cur = current_channel(ch)
    i_meas = np.median(r.col(cur.col) / cur.gain)
    v1 = [c for c in ch if c.col.startswith("sr1")][0]
    B, R = r.col("magnet_field"), (r.col(v1.col) / v1.gain) / i_meas
    o = np.argsort(B)
    return r, B[o], R[o], i_meas

r6, B6, R6, I6 = spot_load(6)
print(summarize_run(r6))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 3.2))
ax[0].plot(B6, R6, lw=0.6)
ax[0].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel=r"$R_{xx}$ ($\Omega$)", title=f"run 6 raw: n=+3.2e12, D=0, I={I6*1e9:.2f} nA, sr1 50 uV FS = {50e-6/1.0/I6:.0f} $\\Omega$")
m = B6 >= 1.0   # fine-grid (10 mT) leg only
dR = R6[m] - np.polyval(np.polyfit(B6[m], R6[m], 5), B6[m])
ax[1].plot(1/B6[m], dR, lw=0.6)
ax[1].set(xlabel="1/B (1/T)", ylabel=r"$\Delta R_{xx}$ ($\Omega$)", title="background-subtracted (B >= 1 T leg)")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# Run 6 — onset + 1/B FFT vs the FS-count model (fs_count_b0), electron side n = +3.2e12.
import sys
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count"))
import fs_count_b0 as fsm

n6 = 3.2e16                                  # m^-2 (run-5 cal; scale = geometry prior)
FL6 = luttinger_frequency(n6)                # 33.1 T
_, orbs = fsm.abab_fs(n6)                    # ABAB Onsager pair at the geometry-prior scale
F_abab = [F for F, _ in orbs]
print(f"F_L(g=4) = {FL6:.1f} T | model ABAB pair = {F_abab[0]:.2f} + {F_abab[1]:.2f} T | ABCA singleton = F_L")

on6 = sdh_onset(R6, B6, r_full_scale=50e-6 / I6)
print(on6.summary())
print("NB: sub-1 T leg is 50 mT background-only — cannot Nyquist a 7.5 T tone below ~0.9 T, so the")
print("    'censored @ 0.30 T' carrying tone and the censored low tones (3.0/4.2/5.1/9.5 T) ride an")
print("    aliased leg. Onset is UNMEASURED; run 8 (low-field extension) pins it.")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.6))
for cut in (1.0, 1.3, 1.6):
    freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R6[:, None], B6, b_range=(cut, B6.max()), bg_degree=5)
    ax.plot(freqs, spec[0] / spec[0].max(), lw=0.8, label=f"cut {cut:.1f} T")
ax.axvline(FL6, color="k", ls="--", label=f"F_L = {FL6:.1f} T")
for F in F_abab:
    ax.axvline(F, color="tab:red", ls=":", label=f"ABAB model {F:.1f} T")
for k in range(1, 5):
    ax.axvline(k * 7.45, color="0.6", lw=0.5)
ax.set(xlim=(0, 70), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="FFT (norm)",
       title="run 6 FFT in 1/B (B >= cut): comb 7.5/14.9/22.4/29.8 (grey: k x 7.45)")
ax.legend(fontsize=7, ncol=2)
plt.show()

**Read (run 6, electron n = +3.2×10¹²):** Strong SdH, high SNR, deep minima (QH-like structure above ~7.5 T). Tone set on the clean B ≥ 1 T leg: **{7.5, 14.9, 22.4, 29.8} T ≈ {1,2,3,4} × 7.45 T**, comb members visible to ~8×, with the **4× line the strongest** — not a monotone harmonic comb. Two hypotheses survive at one density:

1. **ABAB pair + breakdown sum tone**: light f₁ ≈ 7.5, heavy f₂ ≈ 22.4, and f₁+f₂ = 29.9 (the symmetry-allowed inter-block breakdown orbit at F_L). Internally Luttinger-closed with one global density scale ≈ 0.90 (inside the lever-arm prior 0.8–1.2). Model pair at prior scale: {7.31, 25.78} T; measured partition 0.25/0.75 vs model 0.22/0.78 at n_eff = 2.9×10¹².
2. **Single ~7.45 T pocket with strong harmonics**: but a lone 7.45 T pocket carries only 0.23·F_L at g = 4 — a Luttinger-sum violation — and the 4× ≫ 3× amplitude ordering is unnatural for pure harmonics.

The 22.4 T tone sits within δF of exactly 3×7.45 — the harmonic-screen trap the investigation names ("never discard a tone as a harmonic when doing so breaks the partition sum"). **One density cannot decide; the fan's n-dependence does**: the model's ABAB heavy/light ratio drifts 3.5 → 4.8 → 17 over n = 3.2 → 2.0 → 1.0×10¹², while a harmonic stays pinned at exactly 3.000.

**Onset is unmeasured**: the carrying tone is censored at the record edge, and the sub-1 T leg (50 mT) cannot Nyquist a 7.5 T tone below ~0.9 T — the censored low tones (3.0/4.2/5.1/9.5 T) are alias candidates from that leg, not claimed. Run 8 (low-field extension, 2.5 mT) pins the onset for the fan's B_lo and doubles as the grid-change reproduction check on those tones.

## Run 7 — `sdh-spot-check`, hole side: n = −1.2×10¹² cm⁻², D = 0 (B 10 → 0.3 T ride-down)

Second Step-3 spot check (no side prior): hole side at the largest |n| the D = 0 line reaches within gate limits (−1.27×10¹²). 20 mT uniform-B, magnet ride-down from run 6's endpoint; sr1 50 µV, dwell 3 s.

# Run 7 — onset + 1/B FFT, hole side n = -1.2e12 (F_L = 12.4 T).
FL7 = luttinger_frequency(1.2e16)
on7 = sdh_onset(R7, B7, r_full_scale=50e-6 / I7)
print(f"F_L(g=4) = {FL7:.1f} T")
print(on7.summary())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.6))
for cut in (0.75, 0.9, 1.1):
    freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R7[:, None], B7, b_range=(cut, B7.max()), bg_degree=5)
    ax.plot(freqs, spec[0] / spec[0].max(), lw=0.8, label=f"cut {cut:.2f} T")
ax.axvline(FL7, color="k", ls="--", label=f"F_L = {FL7:.1f} T")
ax.set(xlim=(0, 40), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="FFT (norm)",
       title="run 7 FFT in 1/B (B >= cut): dominant ~7 T + ~2x/3x comb; low tone 2-3 T wanders with cut")
ax.legend(fontsize=7)
plt.show()

**Read (run 7, hole n = −1.2×10¹²):** SdH clear (onset 0.71 T — measured, this side's grid is trustworthy from 0.3 T) but the tone set is messier, as the model expects near CNP on the hole side (close, balanced pair — beat-like on short records): dominant ~6.9–7.4 T (position wanders with the FFT cut), a ~2×/3× comb, a candidate close pair {4.7, 6.6} whose sum ≈ 11.3 sits near F_L = 12.4 T, and a strong 12.3 T tone (SNR 125) at ≈ F_L itself — pair-sum/breakdown candidate. The 2–3 T low tone wanders with cut → background residual, not claimed.

**Side call for the fan: electron.** Cleaner, higher-SNR tone set; the D = 0 hole window tops out at |n| = 1.27×10¹² (gate limits) — inside the low-|n| exception regime where templates converge — while the electron side reaches +3.2×10¹² where they separate. Hole-side facts (onset 0.71 T, tone set) go to the hedges of the final call.

## HERA — onset extension before the fan (`sdh-spot-check` low-field leg, electron side)

> **05:29** · onset extension: n=+3.2e12 D=0 electron point (run-6 spot), B 0.25->1.10 T uniform-B 2.5 mT (341 pts), sr1 50 uV, dwell 3 s · **ETA ~06:04** (≈35 min)

The fan is next (operator request; investigation Step 4, electron side per the runs 6/7 read in ana). But `landau-fan` step 1 makes B_lo the **measured** onset from `sdh_onset`, and run 6's carrying tone (7.5 T) is `censored` at the record edge — its sub-1 T leg was a 50 mT background leg that cannot Nyquist a 7.5 T tone below ~0.9 T, so the onset is genuinely unmeasured. A censored carrying tone means a cheap low-field extension pins B_lo before committing the multi-hour fan (the fan's cost is steep in B_lo: uniform-1/B rows and the n-axis Nyquist floor both blow up if we guess low). This leg: same operating point as run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹², D = 0), B 0.25 → 1.10 T at 2.5 mT — Nyquist-clean for the carrying tone at the low edge — also serving as the grid-change reproduction check on run 6's censored sub-1 T tones (real tones survive the grid change; aliases of the 50 mT leg move). Ends at 1.10 T with gates on the spot; the fan starts from the measured onset just below.

Checkpoints: first rows (leakage, sensible R ≈ 50–80 Ω, no rail), then the completed record → `sdh_onset` → fan design lands in the next cell.

# === SdH onset extension, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12, D = 0; B 0.25 -> 1.10 T, 2.5 mT ===
# Pins the onset for the landau-fan B_lo (run 6's carrying tone is censored on the aliased 50 mT leg);
# doubles as the grid-change reproduction check on run 6's sub-1 T censored tones (3.0/4.2/5.1/9.5 T).
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)   # run-5 cal
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V "
      f"(same point as run 6)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set): handoff state0 — gates 0, field 0, base T ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform B, 2.5 mT, ascending 0.25 -> 1.10 T. At the 0.25 T low edge
# d(1/B) = dB/B^2 = 0.040 -> Nyquist F = 12.5 T > 1.5x the 7.5 T carrying tone (2nd harmonic
# clean above 0.42 T; harmonics are negligible near onset). Ends at 1.10 T, overlapping run 6's
# fine leg by 0.1 T for cross-normalization; fan then starts from the measured onset nearby.
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.arange(0.25, 1.10001, 0.0025), 5))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)   # inherit run 6 (R <= 120 Ohm below 1.1 T = 2.4% FS of 5 kOhm; headroom fine)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, 2.5 mT; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, "
      f"tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell, as runs 6/7)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"sdh-spot-check onset extension, electron: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} (run-5 cal), "
                  f"(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.25 -> 1.10 T 2.5 mT, sr1 50 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron onset extension: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; '
              f'(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); B 0.25 -> 1.10 T uniform-B 2.5 mT; '
              f'pins landau-fan B_lo (run 6 carrying tone censored on aliased 50 mT leg); '
              f'grid-change check on run-6 sub-1 T tones; cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 1.10 T — the fan ramps down to its measured B_lo from here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")

Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
